signal: REBA acquired Markerr (Dec 2025), moved to Microsoft Fabric in REBA 4.0, and launched BI TrueSight plus rebaAI across its multifamily data products

email.body1:
Adam, saw REBA acquired Markerr, moved to Microsoft Fabric in 4.0, and launched BI TrueSight and rebaAI.

That much new product usually opens more multifamily accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp on the story, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for REBA off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Adam, quick follow-up for REBA.

An acquisition plus a platform refresh widens the multifamily target list faster than the team can dial it, so strong operators sit untouched. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the number.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings REBA needs for the data products this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Adam, last bit of proof for REBA.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how REBA reply rate likely compares to peer data-analytics teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Adam, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority right now, no problem. Integrating Markerr and shipping 4.0 is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a data-products motion? I will tailor it to REBA either way.
